comment: Validation model matrix. path is relative to HV_ROOT (validation config) unless absolute. weights_gb sizes gpu_memory_utilization; min_vram_gb skips a model on smaller devices. hf_id is the download source for download_models.py, and an optional revision (branch, tag or commit sha; default main) pins it. fallback_ops lists plugin op families the model exercises but the plugin is expected to leave on fallback, so e2e_matrix.py does not require a hipDNN route for them.

models.name: qwen3-8b
models.covers: GQA, head dim 128. Stands in for Llama-3.1-8B, which is gated on Hugging Face (the matrix allows either).

models.name: gemma-3-4b
models.covers: head dim 256, sliding window, GemmaRMSNorm; text only. unsloth/gemma-3-4b-it is an ungated copy of google/gemma-3-4b-it (gated).

models.name: gpt-oss-20b
models.covers: attention sinks (sink_token in the P2a/P2b graphs), sliding-window layers, MXFP4 MoE

models.name: qwen2.5-vl-3b
models.covers: ViT encoder attention, vision LayerNorm/conv when enabled, Qwen2 decoder

models.name: qwen2.5-0.5b
models.covers: small smoke/bisect model covering attention, norms and linear together

models.name: gemma-3-4b-strict-bigkv
models.covers: gemma-3-4b in strict mode with a KV pool past 4 GiB, so its shared hybrid-allocator K/V tensors pass the 2 GiB that a 32-bit page container would allow; run with the attention candidate so any decoder-attention decline fails the run
